title: 目標達成の後に・アタシの戦場！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My training arc is complete! Trainer and I have decided that sprints and miles are the best races for me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But Trainer feels bad because that means it'll be harder for me to race against Yaeno and the others. After all, they mostly run in mid and long distances…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's not that I don't want to run with everyone, but I know I've got to become an awesome racer if I want to run in hot-blooded races!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: For now, I'll do everything I can to become the top racer in sprints and miles! Next up, I'm taking on a graded sprint called the Swan Stakes!
